scripts.emulators: pnpm --filter functions build && tools/with-java.sh firebase emulators:start --project demo-musicweb
scripts.test:int: pnpm --filter functions build && tools/with-java.sh firebase emulators:exec --project demo-musicweb --only functions,firestore,auth "vitest run --config vitest.int.config.ts"
scripts.scan:bundle: pnpm --filter web build && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tools/scan-bundle.ts apps/web/dist
scripts.test:rules: tools/with-java.sh firebase emulators:exec --project demo-musicweb --only firestore,storage "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
